name: Topend.Com.Au
summary: NT/QLD dialup ISP (Darwin, Katherine, Alice Springs, Tennant Creek, Mt Isa, Cloncurry, Townsville hubs); 'The First With 2MB In The Territory'; acquired into the Edge/Eisa group c. 2000; defunct.

events.details: Operating by 10 Apr 1997. 1997 IP index: TOPEND-AU 203.23.240.0/22, TOPENDCOMAU-AU 203.31.28.0/22, TOPEND2-AU 203.24.39.0/24, TOPENDCOMAU1-AU 203.39.4.0/22 (PO Box 819 Katherine NT 0851; GPO Box 2947 Darwin NT 0801). topend.com.au (5 Jun 1997): local-call access Darwin/Katherine/Tennant Creek/Alice Springs/Mt Isa/Cloncurry; web-based email; 'The First With 2MB In The Territory'.

refs.label: IP Network Index 1997: TOPEND-AU / TOPENDCOMAU-AU / TOPEND2-AU / TOPENDCOMAU1-AU

events.details: Acquired into the Edge/Eisa group c. 2000 (Eisa Limited, trading as Edge Internet Services Australia; see eisa-limited + acquisition transition; Eisa registered 'EISA TOPEND' and 'TOPEND.COM.AU' business names); brand/domain continued under successors after Eisa's collapse (Austar -> Virtual Communities -> iiNet). Last active capture of topend.com.au (Aug 2006).
